messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: Incident PD-78910 for service `redwood-inference-api-prod` -> routed to `support-general`. Trigger: 5xx-rate > 5% on /v1/generate. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-78910

pagerduty-bot: PD-78910 created by monitor `api-5xx-rate` · urgency: high · escalation policy: support-team-policy

Elena (eng-oncall): I didn't get a page. Support got pinged. Anyone change the PD service bindings?

Jules (prod-support): We got 3 pages and already fielded a couple customer emails. We forwarded to Eng but were told this should be routed directly to eng-oncall. cc @Elena

Samir (sre): Looking. Running `pd service get redwood-inference-api-prod` now.

Samir (sre): output:
```
name: redwood-inference-api-prod
escalation_policy: support-team-policy
integration_key: XXXXX
```
:facepalm: That escalation policy is wrong — should be `eng-oncall-policy`. I see a recent change in PD bindings in PR #342 (deploy infra) that updated a list of services.

Maya (eng): Oof. Can we reassign immediately? Support is overloaded and this is delaying engineering response.

Samir (sre): Doing emergency update: `pd service update redwood-inference-api-prod --escalation-policy eng-oncall-policy`

Samir (sre): CLI output: `Service redwood-inference-api-prod updated -> escalation_policy: eng-oncall-policy`

pagerduty-bot: PD-78910 reassigned to escalation policy `eng-oncall-policy`. Notification sent to current on-call.

Elena (eng-oncall): Acking now.

Elena (eng-oncall): acked PD-78910 — investigating. Initial cause looks like a small surge from a downstream batch job; spikes hitting a buggy deserialization path.

incident-bot: Note: Auto-escalation earlier caused duplicate pages to support's second-level responders; those alerts were fired between 1845123468-1845123525 and then canceled after reassignment.

Jules (prod-support): Customer impact: Halley Analytics had ~18 minutes of degraded responses starting ~1845123400. We opened support tickets HAL-1122, HAL-1123 and provided temporary mitigation steps. They reported timeouts and repeated 502s.

Samir (sre): Mitigation steps applied:
- disabled the flapping monitor for 20m (`monitor api-5xx-rate -> muted`)
- rolled forward hotfix (commit `abc123`) that adds defensive null-check -> reduced 5xxs

Samir (sre): metric snapshot (5m window): 5xx-rate dropped from 6.9% -> 0.8%

Elena (eng-oncall): Confirming errors back to normal over last 5m. Watching for 10m. Will leave live tail on logs.

Maya (eng): Can we add a temporary PD reroute for the service until we fix the config drift? I'd also like a manual escalation channel (phone) for this customer while we sort PD.

Samir (sre): Created a temporary route and silenced support channel for this service. Also pinged on-call phone for Halley Analytics account.

Jules (prod-support): Thx. We'll notify CS/Account team — they want a short note and timeline.

Elena (eng-oncall): Quick notes for the incident record:
- root cause: PagerDuty service escalation_policy incorrectly set to `support-team-policy` due to PR #342 touching service mappings
- impact: one customer (Halley Analytics) experienced ~18m degraded responses; 3rd party monitor triggered repeated pages to Support instead of Eng-Oncall
- mitigation: updated PD service binding, muted monitor, deployed hotfix `abc123`

Samir (sre): Action items (assignments):
- Samir: revert/patch PR #342 and add CI check to validate PD service -> escalation policy mapping (due EOD)
- Elena: runbook update: add pre-merge check for PD bindings + add PD routing verification step to oncall handoff (due tomorrow)
- Jules: customer comms & post-incident note for Halley (due today)
- Maya: add an automated PD routing test in CI that simulates a firing monitor (follow up)

Elena (eng-oncall): Also recommend weekly audit of PD service bindings. This drift has bitten us twice in last 6 months.

Samir (sre): Filed incident ticket INC-9876 in Jira, linked PD-78910, assigned to me for remediation work.

Jules (prod-support): Customer comms drafted and handed off to CS. They requested a short summary + ETA for root cause analysis.

Elena (eng-oncall): All green here. Leaving monitoring for 30m then will demote to watch. Good job all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-78910 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing thread for live coordination; please continue updates in INC-9876 for the postmortem and follow-ups.

Samir (sre): I'll run a small postmortem doc and include checklist items. Linking here when ready.

Jules (prod-support): Marking this thread resolved from support side.

Elena (eng-oncall): closing.
